585358cc5a.q: What will happen to independent grocery retailers that cannot compete with major chains by 2035?
585358cc5a.a: Between 20 to 30% of independent grocery retailers and smaller retailers will go out of business by 2035 because they lack purchasing power, technology, logistics infrastructure, and the ability to create micro ecosystems for logistics and supply chain. Most grocery retailers have operated using the same model popularized since 1916 with the first Piggly Wiggly store, and innovation will become a premium differentiator only accessible to major players like Walmart, Target, and Amazon.
